appDesc.message: Sort your Instagram saved posts and followed accounts into topics, with a short digest for each.

noBookmarks.message: No digests yet. Open a topic in Saved and press “Make digest”.

syncingFollowers.message: Fetching your followers (to find mutual-follow friends)…

noDigestYet.message: This topic has no digest yet.

mergeHint.message: "$1" already exists. Enter merges the two topics and their digests.

confirmDeleteCat.message: Delete "$1"? Its $2 follows and saved posts become unsorted and the AI sorts them again on the next run. Its digests are deleted too.

mergingSmall.message: Moving $1 small topics into similar ones…

rateLimited.message: Gemini rate limit. Retrying in $1 s…

loginFirst.message: Log in to instagram.com in this browser first.

igFailed.message: Could not read Instagram. Reload the instagram.com tab and sync again.

followingShrank.message: Got only $1 of $2 followed accounts, so the old list was kept. If you really unfollowed them, press Sync once more to accept the new list.

needKey.message: Synced. Add a Gemini API key in Settings to sort into topics.

welcomeTitle.message: Sort your Instagram in three steps

welcomeLead.message: About 5 minutes. Your data stays on this computer.

s1Open.message: Open the key page and sign in with your Google account:

s1Create.message: Click “Create API key”. It is free.

s1Paste.message: Copy the key (it starts with AIza) and paste it below.

s1Note.message: The key stays on this computer and is only sent to Google Gemini. The free tier is enough.

keyBad.message: This key does not work. Check that you copied all of it; it starts with AIza.

keyDenied.message: This key cannot use Gemini. Create a new key in AI Studio.

keyBusy.message: Google turned the request down (too many requests or no quota left). Try again in a minute.

keyOffline.message: Cannot reach Google. Check your internet connection and try again.

keyOther.message: Google returned an error (HTTP $1). Try again later.

s2Title.message: Sign in to Instagram, then sync

s2Login.message: Sign in to instagram.com in this Chrome.

s2Sync.message: Press Sync. It only reads your own saved posts and following list. It never posts, likes or changes anything.

s2Time.message: The first sync takes a few minutes. It waits 2–5 seconds between pages to keep your account safe.

s3Busy.message: Sorting now. Progress is in the status bar below. Your topics open when it is done.

clubLine.message: Want to learn more AI tools? Wonder Pocket Club has step-by-step lessons.

refinePlaceholder.message: e.g. condense into formulas, like Sales = pain scenario + solution

confirmDeleteDigest.message: Delete this digest? Other digests in this topic are kept.

apiKeyHelp.message: Free key: aistudio.google.com/apikey. Stored only in this browser.

model.message: Sorting model (many calls: pick one with a high free quota)

summaryModel.message: Digest model (pick one that writes well)

quotaOut.message: Daily free quota for $1 is used up; it resets in about $2 h. Change the model in Settings or enable billing on the API key. Everything sorted so far is saved.

tidyMergeHint.message: Merge these overlapping topics? Untick any you want to keep apart. Their digests move too.

tidyNoMerge.message: No overlapping topics found. The definitions below steer future sorting.

tidyDone.message: Tidied: merged $1 topics. $2 topics have a definition.

tidyEmpty.message: Gemini returned no definitions. Try again.

confirmResort.message: Re-sort everything? AI topics and all digests are rebuilt (topics you set by hand are kept); this uses many Gemini calls.

confirmClear.message: Delete all synced lists and digests? Settings are kept.

nextStep.message: Next: you know what you save most. Turn it into a direction → Wonder Pocket Club classroom, Lv1 "See yourself in your saves"
